prompt:

Each object: claim (falsifiable string), testable_form {statistic,data,baseline,direction} (all strings), prediction (replication condition string), resemblance_target (null or {target,mapping}), kill_threshold (number >0 and <=1), observation_ids (list of ids from observations below). Cite >=1 visible observation per card. Do not assert exclusive baselines for the same data. A baseline declares the distribution the claim says fits, not an opponent. For a displayed spacing histogram use data="source_gaps"; otherwise describe the data. No proofs, reasoning, adoption or assumed replication. Observations:
